proposed_update_frequency.osm_reference: weekly offline extract and change detection; approved snapshot only
proposed_update_frequency.bus_operator_static: daily where official permitted GTFS; else manual updates
proposed_update_frequency.bus_realtime: only if official GTFS-RT and legal service agreement
proposed_update_frequency.official_planning: monthly source monitor plus event-driven checks of new/amended decision
proposed_update_frequency.road_construction: weekly official status checks; approval before public change

critical_policy: Official viewer availability does not equal open API or republishing rights
Every planned road/land-use polygon has legal plan ID, approval and effective date, and possibly superseding amendments
OSM proposed/construction tags cannot certify official investment status
A land-use intersection on a research GPS point does not certify legal zoning of a parcel
Bus stops without source-confirmed status are OSM references, not active service claims
Never embed paid GIS RegisterKey, token or API secret in repo or public client
No auto-export from Google Maps or third-party maps to open basemap
